checks.name: Actual local constructor and combat deaths use the existing compact black/white left notice with their real names
Engine, BroadcastChannel and log copies of one death appear once and do not extend its notice timeout
Different death IDs at the same time and the same ID at a different time remain distinct events
Malformed, foreign-player, non-finite, stale and future loss packets cannot display a notice
Loss names are plain text and cannot retain a research report action from an earlier notice
Native round/camera notices, research completion and Game saved preserve their established text and common route
Incremental log fallback skips startup history and waits for complete death packets
Battle end rejects late losses and Duel continues to install no Towers notice listeners or polling

scope: Real Towers notice controller in VM with structured fatal-loss packets and all existing output transports. Native score/audio/destruction and visible APK behavior are verified separately.
